info.title: 90DNS Tester
info.author: meganukebmp
info.description: Test whether Nintendo network services are blocked.
info.details:
90DNS Tester checks network connectivity to determine whether Nintendo services are being successfully blocked.

Useful for verifying 90DNS-style DNS configurations and other network setups intended to prevent connections to Nintendo's servers while retaining general internet access.
